{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-run the analysis with proper function calls

def note_finding(message):
    print(f"[FINDING] {message}")

# Re-read data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for sentinel values
print("Sentinel values in `revenue`:", sales_df['revenue'].unique())

# Check the `converted` column
print("Unique values in `converted`: ", sales_df['converted'].unique())

# Check status of converted customers
converted_completed = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]['status'].value_counts()
print("Status distribution for converted customers:\n", converted_completed)

# Calculate mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Calculate mean age of non-converted customers
mean_age_non_converted = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 0]['customer_age'].mean()

# Cross-tabulate `converted` vs `customer_segment`
print("\nCross-tabulation: converted vs customer_segment:\n", pd.crosstab(sales_df['converted'], sales_df['customer_segment']))

# Cross-tabulate `converted` vs `channel`
print("\nCross-tabulation: converted vs channel:\n", pd.crosstab(sales_df['converted'], sales_df['channel']))

# Output the final result
print(f"\nMean age of converted customers: {mean_age_converted}")"}
